atlas.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a richly painted SQUARE illustration ATLAS for an existing Colt Radio music-player skin named Moonwalk Magic, a tasteful MICHAEL JACKSON-inspired equine musical tribute. This is ARTWORK ONLY, not a finished radio UI or poster. Exactly THREE separate horizontal regions with crisp straight boundaries: TOP y=0–33% detailed wide nighttime scenic header with NO horse, people or human figures, dark clear CENTRAL title area. MIDDLE y=33–53% blank midnight-black/navy textured material, central x=7–93% uncluttered; narrow ornate side rails only in x=0–7% and93–100%. BOTTOM y=53–100% exactly ONE friendly BLACK HORSE Colt head-and-shoulders portrait, centered x=50%, character occupies x=22–78%, all ears and fedora entirely visible with breathing space, ears start below y=55%, shoulders extend to bottom. Familiar RIGHT-facing THREE-QUARTER equine head angle and visible eyes looking TOWARD THE VIEWER, NOT a symmetric straight-on face. Anatomically long HORSE MUZZLE, natural nostrils, equine ears and long flowing natural charcoal-black mane; absolutely no Michael Jackson human face, no human hands, no human nose or lips. TOP THEME: moody cinematic nighttime street with glowing pearl-white/silver SIDEWALK TILES, cool cobalt-blue rim lighting, a vintage black streetlamp at far left, dark elegant city architecture and low mist at far right, polished wet pavement and subtle cone of concert spotlight crossing the outer edge. Keep the central backdrop dark and clear for HTML title. Billie Jean glowing sidewalk atmosphere with subtle Smooth Criminal elegance, no people/dancer silhouettes. MIDDLE: blank near-black satin/speaker-cloth texture with brushed CHROME vertical side rails, occasional small electric-BLUE light accents on far edges, no buttons or text. BOTTOM: friendly dignified coal-BLACK Colt with charcoal muzzle and expressive warm amber-brown eyes; luminous blue-white rim light keeps every contour of his dark fur readable, tilted BLACK FEDORA with ivory ribbon fitted naturally BETWEEN both fully visible horse ears; white V-neck shirt under cropped tailored BLACK stage jacket with subtle silver-sequin lapel piping. One small raised FOREHOOF at lower right beside shoulder wears a sparkling WHITE SEQUIN hoof-glove fitted to the shape of a HORSE HOOF, NO human fingers or hands; modest confident hat-tip stage attitude, closed mouth gentle smile. Keep head and face dominant for small round player portrait crops, glove lower and secondary. Bottom background near-black navy with faint blue glow. Premium elaborate painted game-interface illustration with beautiful material detail, coherent lighting, handsome natural equine anatomy. Palette midnight black, pearl white, silver and restrained electric blue. No words, text, numbers, lettering, music-note symbols, logos, watermarks, baked buttons, station cards, UI labels or full player mockup. Only ONE horse in bottom region. No extra animals.
